description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.0+ and Java from 8 to 25
tasks.reason: The project uses Java 8 and Spring Boot 2.7.18, both prohibited under Acme Corp internal policy. Java 8, 11, and 17 are end-of-life for internal use, and all Spring Boot 2.x and 3.x must be upgraded to 4.0+. Per the Java upgrade guidelines, since the project uses Spring Boot 2.x, a Spring Boot 4.0+ upgrade task (which includes Java 25 and Jakarta EE migration) is the correct highest-level task.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot from 2.7.18 to 4.0+, upgrade Java from 8 to 25, update pom.xml compiler source/target to 25, migrate from JavaEE (javax.*) to Jakarta EE (jakarta.*) namespaces, and update all dependencies to versions compatible with Spring Boot 4.0+ and Java 25. Target build base image: mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu. Target runtime base image: mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless.

tasks.description: Migrate messaging from RabbitMQ (Spring AMQP) to Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity
tasks.reason: The application uses RabbitMQ with Spring AMQP for messaging (order-created, inventory-alert, approval-pending queues). As part of the Azure migration, RabbitMQ must be replaced with Azure Service Bus using Managed Identity for secure, credential-free authentication per organizational policy.
tasks.requirements: Migrate all RabbitMQ message listeners (OrderMessageListener) from Spring AMQP (@RabbitListener) to Azure Service Bus. Migrate the three queues: order.created, inventory.alert, and approval.pending. Use Managed Identity for authentication. Remove hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials from application.yml. Remove spring-boot-starter-amqp dependency and replace with Azure Service Bus dependencies.

tasks.description: Validate and fix all CVE vulnerabilities in project dependencies
tasks.reason: User explicitly requested that all CVE issues are fixed. After upgrading and transforming the project, a security scan must verify that no known CVE vulnerabilities remain in the dependency tree.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVE vulnerabilities and remediate all identified issues to achieve a clean security posture.
tasks.environmentConfiguration: Runtime: Java 25, Build tool: Maven, Framework: Spring Boot 4.0+ (established by previous tasks)

tasks.description: Update Dockerfile for Java 25 and Azure Container Apps deployment
tasks.reason: The existing Dockerfile uses Java 8 base images (maven:3.8-openjdk-8, eclipse-temurin:8-jre). It must be updated to use the target Java 25 base images for Azure Container Apps deployment.
tasks.requirements: Update the Dockerfile to use mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-ubuntu as the build stage image and mcr.microsoft.com/openjdk/jdk:25-distroless as the runtime stage image. Ensure the container is optimized for Azure Container Apps.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps
tasks.reason: Per Acme Corp charter, the default modernization strategy for Java services in the supply chain system is to replatform to Azure Container Apps (ACA). The user requested migration to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the containerized SupplyChain Worker application to Azure Container Apps. Configure Managed Identity for Azure Service Bus access.
